items.title: Geno Smith: Heads back to medical tent Sunday
items.text:
Smith (ankle) headed back to the medical tent during Sunday's game against the Bills,  Rich Cimini of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Woody Marks: Won't return to Sunday's game
items.text:
Marks (concussion) has been downgraded to out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Browns.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Geno Smith: Back in Sunday's game
items.text:
Smith has cleared the NFL's concussion protocol and has returned to Sunday's game against the Bills, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network and ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam LaPorta: Quiet trip to Munich
items.text:
LaPorta caught one of four targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munch.

items.title: Woody Marks: Getting checked for head injury
items.text:
Marks is being evaluated for a possible concussion during Sunday's game at Cleveland.
